punchline: Taleb's turkey grows more confident with every meal for a thousand days, right up to the Wednesday before Thanksgiving.
thirty_sec: Taleb tells it with a turkey. It's fed every day, and every meal convinces it a bit more that humans are looking after it. Then comes the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. It felt safest exactly when the risk was highest. His answer is the barbell. Keep most of your money extremely safe and a small slice in very speculative bets, so no surprise can push you below the floor and some surprises can make you a lot.
